events.title: Remembering Woodstock 1969
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture history, took place on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people descended on a dairy farm for three days of peace, love, and music. What's your favourite iconic Woodstock moment or performance?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world marks the anniversary of the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 today.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: Today we remember Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in '77. His music and influence are still as powerful as ever. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, the influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas. He would have been 55 today.

angles.name: Tupac's Impact
angles.copy: 2026 marks 30 years since we lost Tupac Shakur. His words and music continue to resonate deeply. What's his most iconic lyric for you?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world remembers legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970. He would have been 84 today.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Today we pay tribute to Jimi Hendrix, a true pioneer who redefined the electric guitar. His music is as electrifying today as it ever was. Which Hendrix riff is your favourite?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released on this day in 1969, featuring classic tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is legendary, but what about the music inside? What's your standout track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Happy birthday to Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, who celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude are timeless. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Happy birthday to former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher, who celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Alright, massive happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's the ultimate Oasis or solo track that gets you singing along?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the US on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity feels as relevant as ever. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced its revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: 25 years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed music forever. Remember loading up your first one? How many songs did you cram on it?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Global celebrations mark James Bond Day, commemorating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No,' in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, what's your favourite 007 moment or track?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the birthday of the legendary musician and songwriter John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His songwriting changed the world. What's the Lennon track that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Happy birthday to the iconic comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, who celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment of his comedic genius?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eponymous double album, widely known as 'The White Album,' on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. Its sprawling creativity still fascinates. What's your hidden gem from the double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers the extraordinary showman and Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991. He would have been 80 today.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Today we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence were truly one of a kind. What's your favourite Queen song thanks to Freddie?
